title: Suspicious command execution with lateral-movement traffic on srv01
rationale: A suspicious shell command appears near administrative network traffic. The tool marks this as medium confidence until process parentage or timeline context confirms it.
detection_hint: suspicious_process AND admin_port_network_activity on same host
score_basis: base 75 suspicious execution +15 lateral-movement traffic on admin ports, same host

title: Password-spray followed by successful login for svc-backup
rationale: 5 authentication failures for the same user were followed by a successful login. This is a compact attack chain, not a single noisy event.
detection_hint: auth_failure_count_by_user >= 5 followed by auth_success within window
score_basis: base 60 credential-access pattern +25 confirmed success after repeated failures

title: Suspicious command followed by external callback on srv01
rationale: A suspicious shell command was followed by outbound web traffic to a non-internal test-network address in the same host timeline. This is useful as a triage pivot, but still needs endpoint/network enrichment before containment.
detection_hint: suspicious_process followed by external zeek_conn/web egress on same host
score_basis: base 65 suspicious execution +15 external egress in same host timeline
